concerns.location: research.md: Dataset Strategy — Dataset Fit Analysis
concerns.text: The plan's own fit analysis concedes the required variables are "not guaranteed by schema": prs-v2-sample is a PR-diff corpus, but the research question needs human review comments with bug annotations, linked issue IDs, and issue closed/merged status (FR-011 ground truth). If these columns are absent, the entire human baseline and ground truth collapse to keyword heuristics, and the fallback chain (issue metadata → keyword heuristic) may leave near-zero "verified" ground-truth bugs. The plan should verify the dataset's actual columns before committing, or name a dataset that demonstrably includes review comments and issue links (e.g., a PR-review corpus with comment fields).

≤5 min per PR (FR-015)" × 500 PRs = up to ~41 CPU-hours of inference against a 6-hour global deadline (FR-013) on a 2-CPU runner. StarCoder2-3B CPU generation on full diffs will almost certainly not sustain even ~0.7 min/PR, so the RuntimeGuard will skip most of the sample and the effective N will be far below the 200–500 PRs the spec assumes. The plan needs a realistic throughput estimate or a pre-committed reduced-N design (not just graceful skip discovered at runtime).

FR-001 requires extraction from "3-5 specified open-source GitHub repositories"; the plan fetches a single pre-sampled HF Parquet with no repo-selection step. If the dataset cannot be filtered by repo, the plan should state this deviation and its justification explicitly (it currently does not).
